briefs.explicit:
MISSION BRIEF M-007
Units: metres, seconds, kilograms. Time starts at t = 0 when every robot leaves its start location.

Locations (x, y, zone):
- base: (0, 0), outdoor
- water tower top: (35, -119), roof
- warehouse roof: (124, 90), roof
- pump house: (61, 127), indoor
- control room: (23, -76), indoor
- workcell West: (53, -88), indoor
- parking lot: (-34, 11), outdoor
- south yard: (-26, -61), outdoor
- antenna mast: (-38, -102), outdoor

Robots:
- M1 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 8 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 2640 s, including the return to its start.
- D1 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 7.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg). Endurance: 1440 s, including the return to its start.
- D2 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 9.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 900 s, including the return to its start.
- D3 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 9 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg). Endurance: 1020 s, including the return to its start.
- A1 (fixed_arm): installed at workcell West and cannot move; it can only work on tasks located at workcell West. Equipment: robotic arm. Mains-powered (no endurance limit).

Tasks:
- T1: Deliver the toolkit (8 kg) to workcell West. Location: workcell West. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 8 kg).
- T2: Replace the filter cartridge at workcell West. Location: workcell West. Duration: 240 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T3: Replace the filter cartridge at workcell West. Location: workcell West. Duration: 180 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T4: Replace the filter cartridge at workcell West. Location: workcell West. Duration: 240 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T5: Photograph antenna mast for the condition report. Location: antenna mast. Duration: 120 s. Needs: camera.
- T6: Tighten the valve at workcell West. Location: workcell West. Duration: 270 s. Needs: robotic arm. Deadline: finished by t = 600 s.
- T7: Replace the filter cartridge at workcell West. Location: workcell West. Duration: 300 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T8: Run a thermal scan of antenna mast. Location: antenna mast. Duration: 210 s. Needs: thermal camera. Deadline: finished by t = 540 s.
- T9: Photograph pump house for the condition report. Location: pump house. Duration: 90 s. Needs: camera.
- T10: Inspect warehouse roof with a camera. Location: warehouse roof. Duration: 120 s. Needs: camera.

Rules:
1. Every task is done by exactly one robot. A robot does its tasks one at a time, in the order you list them, travelling between task locations.
2. A robot can only do a task if it has the needed equipment, enough payload capacity, and can reach the task location.
3. A task that must start after another task waits until that task is finished, even if a different robot does it.
4. Each robot must be back at its start location before its endurance runs out.
5. Keep at least 1 quadcopter on standby: it must not be given any task.
6. Every task must be finished by t = 1800 s.

Objective: minimise the finish time of the last task (the makespan).
briefs.informal:
Here's what we need from the robots today.

Positions are in metres from the base at (0, 0). Drones fly straight and can't go indoors; ground robots follow the road grid (so they travel |dx| + |dy|) and can't get onto roofs. Everyone leaves their start spot at time zero.

Places: water tower top (35, -119, a rooftop); warehouse roof (124, 90, a rooftop); pump house (61, 127, indoors); control room (23, -76, indoors); workcell West (53, -88, indoors); parking lot (-34, 11, outside); south yard (-26, -61, outside); antenna mast (-38, -102, outside).

The fleet: M1 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 8 kg, moves at 1 m/s and lasts 44 minutes including getting back. D1, a quadcopter waiting at base, carries a camera, cruises at 7.5 m/s, lifts up to 2 kg and has 24 minutes of flight time, return trip included. D2 is a quadcopter at base with a camera and a thermal camera; it flies at 9.5 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 15 minutes including the flight home. D3 is a quadcopter at base with a camera; it flies at 9 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 17 minutes including the flight home. A1 is a robot arm bolted down in workcell West; it can't move but can work on jobs inside workcell West, and it runs on mains power.

Jobs:
(T1) Drop the toolkit off at workcell West; it weighs 8 kg - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.
(T2) Swap the filter cartridge at workcell West - that takes 4 minutes on site.
(T3) Change the filter at workcell West - that takes 3 minutes on site.
(T4) Swap the filter cartridge at workcell West - that takes 4 minutes on site.
(T5) Document antenna mast with pictures - that takes 2 minutes on site.
(T6) The valve at workcell West needs tightening - that takes 4.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 10 minutes.
(T7) Change the filter at workcell West - that takes 5 minutes on site.
(T8) Look for overheating equipment around antenna mast - that takes 3.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 9 minutes.
(T9) We need pictures of pump house for the report - that takes 1.5 minutes on site.
(T10) Have a look at warehouse roof - that takes 2 minutes on site.

Keep one quadcopter on standby; don't give it any jobs. Everything has to be wrapped up within 30 minutes of the start, and the sooner the last job finishes, the better. Every robot has to make it back to where it started before its battery runs out.
